name: BACH_0151
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 for invasive risk [F1], backed by single-class conformal prediction, model consensus, and drafted ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Strong invasive carcinoma probability |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at alpha 10% (90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 26% OOD, 12/12 regions kept [F6] (AUROC 0.70) | Typical image, no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (88%–91% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match suggestion |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · Strongest embedding score (+1.98 contribution; AI spot check 19/20) [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 1, 6) · ↑ invasive · High score (+1.00 contribution), but 0/20 AI spot check, unreliable [F3] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 7, 10) · ↑ invasive · Elevated embedding score (+0.72 contribution; AI spot check 18/20) [F4] · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 6, 9, 10) · context · HoVer-Net nuclear area CV 0.73, 100th reference percentile [F8] · Measured
- **Tumor cell fraction and TILs** (regions 6, 9, 10) · context · 57% neoplastic nuclei (91st percentile) [F7]; TIL proximity 92nd percentile [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 regions drops risk above random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Not shown faithful (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20 check).

## Could be wrong if
- Atypical cells remain duct-confined (InSitu, like contrast case BACH_0063 at 76% similarity) without true stromal invasion.
- High-risk regions reflect tangential duct sectioning or dense lymphocytes (region 4) mimicking stromal invasion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 7**: Confirm true stromal invasion beyond the basement membrane versus duct-confined InSitu carcinoma.
2. **Regions 0, 7, 10**: Verify nuclear pleomorphism directly; count mitoses manually in **0, 1, 6** (unreliable 0/20 score).
3. **Regions 6, 9, 10**: Confirm sampled tumor cellularity (58–90 neoplastic nuclei/region) before approving drafted ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 stain orders.
